# Exercise 6

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Exercise 6

In your new Quarto document, load `tidyverse` and `gt` libraries and read in `sleep_breakfast.csv` file under the `data` folder. Inspect the data. What are the variables in the data? 
:::

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  # for data wrangling
library(gt)         # for pretty tables
df <- read_csv('data/sleep_breakfast.csv')
gt(df)
```

There are 4 variables in the data.

* SleepDuration	
* BreakfastPerWeek
* Class
* Campus
